mechanism_name: OICASCADE — open-interest collapse cascade-exhaustion event book
mechanism_story: WHO IS FORCED: holders below maintenance margin — the exchange liquidation engine force-closes them with market orders regardless of price or opinion. A 24h window in which open interest collapses (bottom decile of 24h OI rate-of-change) while price falls is the signature of a long-liquidation cascade: the forced seller is being mechanically removed. WHY THE EFFECT EXISTS: forced selling is price-insensitive and SELF-TERMINATING — it ends exactly when the under-margined inventory is exhausted, and the OI collapse measures precisely that exhaustion (the flow of forced closes, not the stock of leverage). After exhaustion the residual flow is voluntary, the liquidation engine's sell pressure disappears, and the temporary price impact mean-reverts — the documented cascade-exhaustion rebound (deleveraging-spiral mechanics a la Bruno-Shin running in reverse). The rebound is missed by slow participants: margin desks and stop engines react over hours, and the exhaustion instant is visible only in the OI flow, never in the tape alone. OBSERVABLE: r_OI_24h from keyless data.binance.vision futures metrics field sum_open_interest (5-min snapshots), gated at its trailing-120d 10th percentile AND a negative 24h panel price return; the book is LONG the perp for 24h after the event. WHEN IT MUST FAIL: when the OI collapse reflects voluntary basis-trade rotation (farmers unwinding rather than liquidations — no forced seller was removed, no rebound is owed), in persistent bear regimes where each cascade hands off to further fundamental selling, or when the rebound is smaller than a tier-2.0 round trip. NOVELTY TRIPLE vs forbidden OI ancestry (OILev quintiles, OILEV-V2 + inverted shadow, OITD term structure, OICYC): information source is the OI RATE-OF-CHANGE flow (forced-close velocity) not the OI level/term-structure stock; causal story is forced-liquidation exhaustion and rebound, not leverage-crowd fade or cycle timing; control class is a randomized-event-time sham. D2 measures pooled rho on the exposure series below; > 0.20 vs any OI-family exposure vetoes the family.
universe: BTCUSDT, ETHUSDT, SOLUSDT (published 3-symbol panel; data.binance.vision metrics files exist for all three; SOL is the high-beta attention alt where cascades cluster — event sample breadth)
clock: H4 (H1 panel rows bucketed to UTC H4 — a sanctioned post-extraction derivation; decision at H4 bucket close; fills at next-H4-bucket VWAP)
warmup: Rolling trailing 120-day window of H4 OI changes (720 H4 decisions per symbol of consumed lookback), seeded from pre-S0 data.binance.vision metrics 2025-04-25..2025-08-21 so that the whole S0 window 2025-08-22..2026-08-21 is tradeable across the 3 chronological folds; the window rolls forward and the r_OI_24h P10 threshold is recomputed from past-only H4 closes at every event evaluation.
features_and_lags: Inputs (authorized keyless bulk source, no signup/key): data.binance.vision futures/um/daily/metrics/{SYMBOL} daily CSVs — fields create_time (5-min snapshot instant tau) and sum_open_interest. Derived: OI_s(T) = last sum_open_interest with tau <= T; r_OI_24h(T) = OI_s(T)/OI_s(T - 24h) - 1 (both endpoint snapshots required within +/-30 min tolerance, else undefined); E(T) = 1 iff r_OI_24h(T) <= trailing-120d P10 of past H4 closes AND R_24h(T) < 0. fapi /fapi/v1/openInterestHist is NOT used: its ~30-day history cap cannot fund S0 (coverage-first fail-closed). Panel columns consumed (section 2 names): last_price (R_24h(T) = last_price(T)/last_price(T-24h) - 1 at bucket closes), vwap, quote_total, qty_total (next-H4 VWAP = sum(quote_total)/sum(qty_total) over the H1 rows inside the H4 bucket), symbol, hour_utc / day_utc (H4 bucketing), first_ts_ms / last_ts_ms (alignment). AVAILABILITY LAW: metrics rows admissible iff create_time tau <= T (snapshot-at-tau, never forward-filled beyond tau); panel rows admissible iff close_ts <= T; threshold quantiles use strictly past H4 closes; NO same-bucket close peeking (signal at H4 close T fills at the VWAP of the next H4 bucket). COVERAGE CAVEAT: if vision metrics do not continuously fund S0 for any of the three symbols, this proposal is COVERAGE_INSUFFICIENT_FAIL_CLOSED at P0/P2.
entry_exit_fills: Entry: at the H4 bucket close T of an event (E(T) = 1), fill at the next H4 bucket VWAP (sum quote_total / sum qty_total over its H1 rows). Exit: fill at the VWAP of the first H4 bucket whose close >= T + 24h. One position per symbol; events firing while a position is open are ignored and the book re-arms only after flat (no pyramiding). Force-flat: any open position closes at the last H4 VWAP before the +/-1-day purge zone around each internal fold boundary; no fills and no carries inside purge zones; no position ever touches S1.
costs: Taker charged EXACTLY ONCE PER FILL (L-V14-0 acknowledged): fee 5.0 bps baseline x tier multiplier (x1.0 / x1.5 / x2.0) with slip floors 1 / 1 / 2 ticks; TIER 2.0 IS THE PRIMARY BOOK — all expectancies, gates (G1-G12) and pre-registered kills below are evaluated at tier 2.0; stress multipliers apply to booked PnL.
anchor: OICASCADE-A: per symbol s in {BTCUSDT, ETHUSDT, SOLUSDT}, at H4 close T with E(T) = 1 (bottom-decile 24h OI collapse AND negative 24h panel return): take LONG +1, entered at next-H4-bucket VWAP, held until the VWAP of the first H4 bucket whose close >= T + 24h; position series in {0, +1}, one unit notional, one position per symbol, overlapping events ignored.
neighbour: OICASCADE-N: same mechanism, different frozen parameters — gate at trailing-120d P5 of r_OI_24h (more extreme collapses) with 48h holding instead of P10/24h; identical long direction, fills and costs. Roughly half the events with twice the holding. Probes rebound persistence beyond the cascade window; must independently satisfy G1-G5 to count as neighbour support (G10).
control: Randomized-event-time sham (event-mechanism control class): with fixed seed 1717, draw per symbol the SAME number of 24h LONG windows (matched count, identical fills and once-per-fill tier-2.0 costs, identical force-flat) at H4 closes sampled uniformly over S0, excluding +/-1 day fold purge zones and any close within +/-3 days of a true event (redraw on collision); direction always +1 as in the anchor. This severs the conditioning link (OI collapse + down-move) while preserving unconditional long exposure. The convenient explanation it must NOT reproduce: 'any 24h long window in crypto drifts upward' (beta/drift). Per G11, if the sham earns the same sign with |sham exp| >= 0.5 x |anchor exp|, the family DIES (falsification-by-control).
exposure_series_spec: D2 conditioning exposure for symbol s and H4 bucket with close T: OI_s(T) = last sum_open_interest in data.binance.vision metrics rows with create_time tau <= T; r_OI(T) = OI_s(T)/OI_s(T-24h) - 1 (endpoint snapshots within +/-30 min of the two closes, else undefined = 0); P10_s(T) = quantile_{0.10}{r_OI(T') : H4 closes T' in (T - 120d, T]}; R_24h(T) = last_price(T)/last_price(T-24h) - 1 from panel H1 rows with close_ts <= T. Event(T) = 1 iff r_OI(T) <= P10_s(T) AND R_24h(T) < 0. exposure_s(T') = +1 for H4 closes T' in (T, T+24h] following the most recent Event(T) = 1, else 0. Availability: metrics tau <= T, panel close_ts <= T, quantiles past-only. D2 pools exposure_s(T') over s in {BTCUSDT, ETHUSDT, SOLUSDT} and all S0 H4 buckets and computes pooled rho vs every forbidden conditioning exposure (OILev quintiles, OILEV-V2 + inverted-OI shadow, OITD, OICYC, and the full inventory).
falsification_rule: Pre-registered mechanical kills (any one kills the family): (K1) CONTROL REPRODUCES — the randomized-event-time sham earns the same (positive) sign with |sham exp| >= 0.5 x |anchor exp| at tier 2.0 pooled over S0 (G11) -> DEAD, unconditional drift/beta explains the anchor. (K2) ANCHOR NEGATIVE — anchor after-cost expectancy <= 0 at tier 2.0 in >= 2 of the 3 chronological folds (G1/G3 territory) -> REJECT. (K3) ANCESTRY VETO — D2 pooled |rho| > 0.20 between the exposure series above and ANY forbidden conditioning exposure (OI families in particular) -> vetoed as re-label; no clock, threshold, universe or sign-flip rescue is permitted.
expected_failure_interpretation: A REJECT means the OI-collapse event does not mark exploitable cascade exhaustion after taker tier-2.0 costs: either the gated events are dominated by voluntary basis-trade rotation rather than forced liquidations (the mechanism is misattributed — the rebound is not owed), the rebound is arbitraged away faster than H4 decisions can capture it, or the exposure collapses into forbidden OI-stock ancestry (control reproduces / pooled rho > 0.20 vs OI families). The forced-liquidation-exhaustion story is falsified on this panel and universe; it is dead and not rescuable by re-clocking or re-gating.
expected_failure_mode: COST DOMINATION — the named risk of this sub-daily frontier: a rare-event book whose per-event rebound is smaller than the fixed tier-2.0 round trip. Turnover estimate: bottom-decile event-state occupancy with heavy clustering -> ~30 entries/year/symbol x 3 symbols = 90 round trips/year = 180 taker fills/year ~ 0.5 fills/day = 0.5 fills / 18 H4 decisions/day ~ 0.028 fills per decision. At tier 2.0 (~10 bps fee + 2-tick slip per fill, ~20-24 bps per round trip) the book needs >= ~24 bps mean 24h rebound per event to clear G1; cascades cluster into volatile stretches where realized slippage is worst, and force-flat fills at fold edges are untimed — the expected kill is cost, not absence of signal.
